Class BucketStateMigration

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.util.BucketStateMigration
public final class BucketStateMigration extends Object
Brings saved bucket-state components up to the current format before their persistent codecs decode them, so the rest of the mod sees only current state.

Two stamps drive the conversion. "schema" is the Some Buckets component format; a component without it was written by the 1.21.1 release. "data_version" is the Minecraft data version of the vanilla entity and item-stack data a component embeds, which vanilla's data fixer does not reach inside mod components; a component without it holds 1.21.1 data. Upgrading runs vanilla's data fixer over that embedded data, and encoding always writes the current stamps. Conversion happens wherever the component is decoded, including inside other mods' storage, and repeats on each load until the holder saves the current form.

    • fluidContent

      public static <A> com.mojang.serialization.Codec<A> fluidContent(com.mojang.serialization.Codec<A> current)
      Wraps the current fluid-content codec. A released component's variant was a loader-native raw tag on Forge, which now travels as the patch's minecraft:custom_data; NeoForge and Fabric already wrote an encoded component patch.
      Parameters:
      current - codec for the current format
      Returns:
      a codec that upgrades released data before decoding and writes the current format
